items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And I think Nunez was with Louisiana Five on some recording.

ctx.x: And I think Nunez was with Louisiana Five on some recording. I'm not sure of the history of those people in New York City. They were with Louisiana Five at times, and I haven't run down very much information. Do you remember the names of any other groups that were in this category generally?
